ordered_observations.account: Red oval ships descend from the top and fire pink circular projectiles downward. The player ship fires white dashes upward, destroying one ship at 00:01, and projects a forward blue cone that locks onto a ship at 00:03.
ordered_observations.threat_origin: Top of the lane from descending red oval ships.
ordered_observations.action_response: Upward white dashes destroy targets; keeping a ship inside the forward cone fills a circular reticle until a 'PATROL' label appears.
ordered_observations.goal_resource_change: Score increases from 0 to 400; PAY increases to 813 with a x1.2 multiplier; WRIT bar fills by one segment; 'Codex: Scout' banner appears.
ordered_observations.uncertainty: Whether the disarm at 00:01 was caused by shooting a specific part of the ship or a special weapon.

ordered_observations.account: The player ship flies close to pink projectiles at 00:09, triggering a pink ring around the ship, then collects a green diamond object at 00:19.
ordered_observations.threat_origin: Pink projectiles descending along the lane.
ordered_observations.action_response: Close proximity to projectiles triggers a graze increment; touching the green crystal collects it and triggers an Onboarding Assistant voice warning.
ordered_observations.goal_resource_change: GRAZE counter reaches x5; Score reaches 1,200; PAY reaches 3,825 (x1.5); WRIT reaches 3 segments.
ordered_observations.uncertainty: What opening the flight recorder crystal actually does to gameplay resources.

heard.words: Drift two is dark. Drift two is dark.
Oh! That crystal is a recovered flight recorder. Please don't open it.

readable_text.text: Onboarding Assistant: Outer Drift. Scouts ahead. Scout fire is light, and completely unprovoked.
Codex: Scout
SCOUT CHANNEL: Drift Two is dark. Drift Two is DARK.

simultaneous_information.competition: Four distinct text/voice locations update simultaneously while pink projectiles approach the ship.
simultaneous_information.consequence: The small in-world 'PATROL' label on the reticle is easily missed if reading the bottom subtitle or top banner.

channels: Left-side 'SCOUT CHANNEL' radio box and distorted voice
simultaneous_information.competition: Distorted radio speech overlaps with music and immediately precedes the assistant's 'whisker' line during tight bullet dodging.
simultaneous_information.consequence: The tiny left-margin radio text requires looking away from the center lane during a close pass.

clips.rating_evidence: Pink projectiles and red ships contrast sharply against the dark blue lane, making threat detection immediate. However, tiny in-world reticle tags ('PATROL') and left-margin radio boxes are hard to read at native scale without looking away from hazards, and voice lines cut each other off at 00:03 and 00:05.
uncertainties: At 00:03 and 00:05, the Onboarding Assistant's speech cuts off mid-sentence when a new trigger occurs.
Exact mechanical difference between destroying a ship and 'disarming' it is not visually obvious on first pass.
clips.minimal_fix: Queue voiceover lines with a short buffer instead of hard-cutting mid-word, and increase the font size of the left-side radio channel text and reticle state labels.

ordered_observations.action_response: Player weaves through gaps in the pink projectile curtains and holds the scan cone on a Dart (00:06) and Lancer (00:11).
ordered_observations.goal_resource_change: GRAZE rises to x5; PAY reaches 612 (x1.5); 'Codex: Dart' and 'Codex: Lancer' banners appear.
ordered_observations.uncertainty: Why score jumps from 0 to 450 between 00:04 and 00:05 without an obvious ship explosion.

ordered_observations.account: White hexagonal turrets fire diagonal streams of pink projectiles. At 00:25, the player triggers a wide circular wave/arc that clears nearby projectiles and disarms ships.

ordered_observations.action_response: Releasing the wide arc at 00:25 consumes the three yellow WRIT segments (turning them blue/empty) and clears projectiles.

cross_clip_summary: Across combat sequences (A–E), visual threat detection is consistently strong (5/5) thanks to high-contrast pink/yellow projectiles against dark lanes, and mechanics like scanning, grazing, and WRIT wave clearing are visually distinct. The primary intelligibility failures are auditory and HUD-related: (1) voiceover channels lack a shared queue or priority ducking, causing the Onboarding Assistant to cut herself off mid-word (A, C) or speak simultaneously over Lane Control and Scout Channel radio voices (B at 00:27, C at 00:20); (2) secondary text channels—specifically left-margin radio transcripts and in-world reticle state labels ('PATROL')—use small fonts far from the player's focal point; (3) Sequence D triggers a boss damage bark ('My POD!') without player weapon fire; (4) Sequence E shows no player health indicator before an abrupt Game Over screen obscures the fatal hit; and (5) Sequence G's ship bloom makes the critical center hitbox gem difficult to distinguish, while Sequence H's portrait crop clips the loadout stats panel off-screen.
